scope: Optional scoped discovery, runnable SDK guidance and task-local batch composition, plus independent pre-review and post-review of E's bounded G0/G1/G2 experiment. This does not preselect a model, create an evaluation framework, or predetermine an efficiency result.
coordination: R review and necessary thread notifications are restored by current REQUEST; routine implementation does not wait for individual approval. E owns its evidence/protocol and designated pilot files; V does not edit them or launch another E chat.

require: Old omitted/default call parameters retain their previous full behavior and compatible fields. New compact/scope modes are explicit and reject invalid ambiguous values.
A requested local scope must not open/hash/traverse unrelated bundle content. Use an unrelated unreadable/tampered/missing sentinel or instrument file access, not output length alone.
Known tools remain directly usable without a discovery, skill read or method-registration prerequisite.
Compact candidates retain actual entrypoint/version/content reference needed to request full original content; expand/read round trip matches underlying bytes.

External/revised bundles remain discoverable/readable via their existing explicit mechanism, not silently restricted to six built-in slugs. Old snapshots remain unchanged and a revision obtains a distinct identity.
Compact output must retain failure/NOT_APPLICABLE/unknown/pending distinctions, actual or unknown cost and reservation state, plus stable references to detailed evidence.
Do not encode null/unknown/not-applicable as numeric zero, suppress partial failures or imply that omitted histories never occurred.
Original detailed result remains retrievable; compact views do not mutate ledger, advance event cursor without a successful consumer decision, settle work or alter admission state.
Report bytes and timing from actual calls with defined encoding/scope; fewer output characters alone does not prove lower total latency or better task quality.
Run new minimal input snippets against actual functions in an isolated fixture and noneditable installation, recording interpreter and module paths. Documentation-only plausibility is insufficient.
Each selected method works independently without a full workflow, fit, skill or MethodVersion gate. Necessary scientific identity/unit/evidence/dependency checks remain enforced.
Inputs/outputs distinguish pure computation, provenance append, execution, validation and admission. A synthetic scientific fixture remains engineering evidence.
Reference reading, actual function calls and host self-report are separately observable. Do not count import as use or a returned resource as full skill adoption.
The host may author/modify one local script using real SDK calls and conditional feedback branches; a meaningful branch inside one script is valid and needs no artificial extra LLM round.
Actual dependencies remain ordered; only independent calls may run concurrently. Failure in one item remains individually reported with its identity and real/unknown costs.
Repeated stable requests and retries do not duplicate charged execution/admission; an unresolved action keeps reservation and cannot be hidden by successes in the same batch.
A batch is not atomic unless the underlying contract actually guarantees it; preserve prior successful partial effects when another item fails.
Do not add an arbitrary-code MCP, global router, unified science DAG, background agent loop, event bus or second ledger. Existing authorization and recovery apply.
Unconditionally executing two alternatives in one script is an explicit comparison, not evidence that the second choice depended on first feedback. Inspect the actual code branch.

e_pre_result_review.status_at_freeze: frequency inventory available; complete experimental protocol not yet seen by V
required_before_formal_comparison: E specifies one bounded useful task family, semantic success/abstain/error categories and critical-error costs before results. Same criteria and input visibility apply to G0/G1/G2.

Frequency evidence has real time window, denominators, raw hashes and deduplication by original call/event identity; category labels and composite-command limitations are explicit. Two engineering tasks cannot establish production frequency.

Split by underlying task/source/event group, not prompts or variants; no related event in development/calibration and evaluation. Historical seen material stays known engineering data. Manual counterexamples are separate.

Freeze finite host calls/inference/compute budgets, stopping/timeouts and exclusions; all arms include failures, abstentions, fallback and preparation/adaptation cost. Do not exclude a difficult case after one arm fails.

G0 uses fixed pre-change baseline and G1/G2 use fixed delivered snapshot/install. Same host model/settings, hardware/resource policy and comparable task inputs; unresolved actual model identity is disclosed and limits causal attribution.

Do not use old sessions with unknown resolved model and differing prompts/caches as if they were matched current controls. Randomize/counterbalance execution order or explicitly constrain the conclusion.
All arms may freely skip/combine/modify methods and stop; do not sabotage G0 with prescribed waste or force G2 to call the model on every item.

Record exact Jev/Laya model repository/checkpoint/revision/architecture/tokenizer/runtime and measured local support, input and option-length limits. No assumed Qwen identity or unsupported speed claim.
G2 candidates are task-local; include not-applicable/unknown/return-to-host. Thresholds fixed using development/calibration only, not self-reported confidence or evaluated labels.
Long input/options must have explicit rejection/chunking/fallback and accounted cost, not silent truncation. Record actual use rate, non-adoption, unavailable model and fallback overhead.

Cold/warm startup and caching are separately defined; report elapsed end-to-end and available segments, host/model round trips, tool counts/returned UTF-8 bytes, cumulative/cached/noncached tokens, model latency/resources and known/unknown fees. Batch latency is not per-item latency.

Compare G1-G0 interface/use effect separately from G2-G1 model increment; Jev and Laya results remain separate. With too few independent groups, report per-case descriptive paired results and uncertainty, not population superiority.
e_pre_result_review.decision_policy: Permit benefit, no benefit or insufficient evidence. Scope adoption recommendations to observed quality/cost and actual frequency; engineering efficiency does not certify scientific M/S/phi/G improvement.

evidence_and_status.passed: Actual independently checked scoped behavior or comparison; raw artifacts and identities available.
evidence_and_status.failed: Observed unmet requirement; retain original failure and distinguish checker assumptions from product failures.
evidence_and_status.not_run: No actual run or required information missing; never filled by older passing evidence.
evidence_and_status.blocked: Concrete external dependency/auth/resource obstacle, stated narrowly.
evidence_and_status.freeze_rule: Do not change criteria to fit outcomes. New scope/clarification uses an explicit dated addendum before its relevant results, preserving this original.

limits: No new scientific scoring or CRO
No old-job restart or broad process termination
Only explicitly authorized isolated bounded decision-model inference resources
V never changes tested implementation or owner tests to make acceptance pass
